title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 38
description: Ten questions on Psalms 38: a prayer from deep pain and guilt, abandoned by friends, yet hoping in Yahweh.

questions.text: What does the psalmist ask Yahweh not to do in his wrath?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says, "Yahweh, don't rebuke me in your wrath."

questions.text: According to verse 2, what has pierced the psalmist?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says, "For your arrows have pierced me."

questions.text: As what does the psalmist describe his iniquities in verse 4?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says his iniquities have gone over his head, as a heavy burden too heavy for him.

questions.text: What has left the psalmist, according to verse 10?
questions.explanation: Verse 10 says, "As for the light of my eyes, it has also left me."

questions.text: Where do the psalmist's kinsmen stand, according to verse 11?
questions.explanation: Verse 11 says his kinsmen stand far away.

questions.text: To whom does the psalmist compare himself in verse 13?
questions.explanation: Verse 13 says he is as a deaf man who doesn't hear and as a mute man who doesn't open his mouth.

answers.text: A blind man who can't see
A deaf man who doesn't hear
A lame man who can't walk
A sleeping man who can't wake

questions.text: What does the psalmist say Yahweh will do in verse 15?
questions.explanation: Verse 15 says, "For I hope in you, Yahweh. You will answer, Lord my God."

questions.text: What will the psalmist declare, according to verse 18?
questions.explanation: Verse 18 says, "For I will declare my iniquity. I will be sorry for my sin."

questions.text: Why are those who render evil for good adversaries to him?
questions.explanation: Verse 20 says they are adversaries to him because he follows what is good.

answers.text: Because he follows what is good
Because he spoke against the king

questions.text: What does the psalmist call the Lord in the last verse?
questions.explanation: Verse 22 says, "Hurry to help me, Lord, my salvation."
